# freedrop

> Direct, end-to-end encrypted file transfer between any two of: a CLI
> (`npx freedrop`) and a browser (https://freedrop.dev/). Peers meet
> through encrypted messages on public MQTT brokers; the bytes flow over
> WebRTC, never through a server. Both ends must be online at the same
> time. Interrupted transfers resume; every file is verified (SHA-256)
> before it appears.

Reach for it when a file has to cross between machines that can't reach
each other's disks — your sandbox or a remote server on one side, a
person's phone or laptop on the other — and nobody wants it uploaded
anywhere. Free, MIT-licensed, no account.

Node 22+. Always run it as `npx -y freedrop …` (`-y` skips npm's
install prompt). Pass `--json` to get one JSON event per line on stdout;
human text then goes to stderr.

## Send a file to a person

```bash
npx -y freedrop --json --timeout 10m report.pdf data.csv
```

Run it in the background. The first stdout line is the `ready` event:
give the person its `link` (they open it in any browser, on any device —
no install) or, if they have a terminal, `npx freedrop <code>`. The
process exits 0 once the receiver has verified every byte. Without
`--timeout` the sender waits for a receiver indefinitely; `--timeout`
counts only time with no transfer under way. Arguments must be regular
files — `tar` a directory first.

## Receive a file from a person

Ask them to open https://freedrop.dev/, pick the files, and send you the
link (or the `npx freedrop <code>` line) it shows. Then:

```bash
npx -y freedrop --json -y -o <dir> '<link or code>'
```

`-y` is required without a terminal (exit 2 otherwise). Each verified
file produces a `saved` event with its absolute `path`; a name already
taken in `<dir>` lands as `name(1).ext`. Keep the person's page open
until the transfer finishes.

## Events (`--json`)

- `ready` (send): `code`, `link`, `files` [{name, size}], `total`
- `incoming` (receive): `files`, `total`, `resumed` (bytes already on disk)
- `progress`: `bytes`, `total` — at most every 10 s, and at 100 %
- `saved` (receive): `name`, `path`, `size`
- `status`: `message` — human-readable, wording may change
- `done`: `total`, `seconds` — then exit 0
- `error`: `error`, `code` (= exit status), `message` — then exit. A
  `connect` error adds `nat` {`here`, `peer`}: each end's {`type`,
  `ipv6`} or null, `type` one of `open`, `cone`, `symmetric`, `blocked`
  (no STUN server answered), `unknown`. `symmetric` on both ends, or
  `blocked` on either, means only a TURN relay will connect them

## Exit statuses

- 0 done, every file verified
- 1 `failed` — anything else; read the message
- 2 `usage` — bad arguments, or a receiver without `-y` and no terminal
- 3 `broker` — no rendezvous broker reachable (network, or `--broker`)
- 4 `connect` — peers met but WebRTC could not connect: retry with
  `--turn cloudflare` (needs CF_TURN_KEY_ID, CF_TURN_API_TOKEN) or
  `--turn turn:host:3478 --turn-auth user:pass` on the sending side
- 5 `verify` — a file failed verification or changed while sending; a
  re-run transfers it fresh
- 6 `declined` — the receiver said no
- 7 `timeout` — `--timeout` passed, or a receiver found no sender (wrong
  code, or the sender is gone)
- 8 `lost` — connection lost mid-transfer; re-run the same command to
  resume
- 130 / 143 `interrupted` — SIGINT / SIGTERM; re-run to resume

Interrupted and lost transfers print the exact command that resumes
them: the receiver re-runs `freedrop -y -o <dir> <code>`, the sender
`freedrop --code <code> <files>`.

## Docs

Every page on freedrop.dev has a Markdown twin at `<page>/index.md`.

- [Overview](https://freedrop.dev/index.md): what freedrop is, how it works, FAQ
- [CLI guide](https://freedrop.dev/cli/index.md): sending and receiving from a terminal — SSH, servers, resume, TURN, every option
- [For agents](https://freedrop.dev/agents/index.md): this guide, for people setting up an agent
- [How it works](https://freedrop.dev/security/index.md): the key, rendezvous, encryption, integrity, NAT — and who sees what
- [freedrop vs croc](https://freedrop.dev/vs/croc/index.md)
- [freedrop vs magic-wormhole](https://freedrop.dev/vs/magic-wormhole/index.md)
- [freedrop vs WeTransfer](https://freedrop.dev/vs/wetransfer/index.md)
- [中文](https://freedrop.dev/zh/index.md): all of the above in Chinese, under /zh/
